sloka: प्राज्वलत् ब्रह्म दण्डः च वसिष्ठस्य कर उद्यतः ।विधूम इव काल अग्निः यम दण्ड इव अपरः ॥१-५६-१९॥
transliteration: prājvalat brahma daṇḍaḥ ca vasiṣṭhasya kara udyataḥ ।vidhūma iva kāla agniḥ yama daṇḍa iva aparaḥ ॥1-56-19॥

translations.english: The staff of Brahma in Vasishta's hand, resembling smokeless fire at the end of the dissolution of the worlds inflamed like another rod of death.
